name: awa
description: Validate, view and simulate Agentic Workflow Architecture (AWA) workflows and customer journeys: the AWA MCP server with its 8 tools, the AWA skill, and the /awa:validate, /awa:show, /awa:simulate and /awa:example commands. Simulation only: no tool, model or production system is called.

repository.title: AWA repository folder
repository.description: The folder of your clone of agentic-workflow-architecture, with the SDK and the MCP server built (docs/guides/connect-ai-assistants.md). Leave it empty when you added the marketplace from that clone: the plugin then finds it by itself.
